name: QAOA MaxCut Optimization
description: Benchmark of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm for solving MaxCut. The original analysis (Farhi, Goldstone & Gutmann, 2014) studies regular graphs, deriving performance guarantees for 2-regular and 3-regular instances at fixed p; benchmark suites extend this to random regular and Erdos-Renyi instances. Tests the quality of approximate solutions as a function of circuit depth (p-levels) and graph size. A standard benchmark for hybrid quantum-classical optimization.
significance: The canonical benchmark for hybrid quantum-classical optimization, testing how QAOA approximation quality scales with circuit depth and graph complexity.

news.title: IonQ and ORNL Win IEEE Quantum Week Best Paper for Generative AI QAOA Circuit Synthesis
news.excerpt: IonQ, ORNL, NVIDIA, and the University of Tennessee–Knoxville presented work showing a trained generative model can synthesise QAOA circuits directly, eliminating the trial-and-error variational loop. On a dense 100-variable combinatorial benchmark, model-generated answer quality roughly doubled as sub-problem size grew; circuit-generation time stayed nearly constant at ~28 seconds versus state-of-the-art variational search scaling to over 11 minutes at 12 qubits. The paper won Best Paper at IEEE Quantum Week 2026.
